sets.title: School Festivals
sets.passage: Many schools in Japan have school festivals every year. Students sing songs, act in plays, and sell food. They can work together with their classmates, so school festivals are good chances to make friends.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why are school festivals good chances to make friends?
modelAnswer: Because students can work together with their classmates.

questions.prompt: Please look at the picture. How many balloons are there?
modelAnswer: There are three balloons.
extraCheckPoints: There are ＋ 数 の形で答えているか

questions.prompt: Please look at the girl. What is she going to do?
modelAnswer: She's going to play the guitar on the stage.
extraCheckPoints: be going to ＋ 動詞の原形で答えているか
絵の女の子はすでにギターを持っているので、思考の吹き出しにある on the stage まで言えるとよい

questions.prompt: What do you usually do after school?
modelAnswer: I usually practice soccer with my friends.

questions.prompt: Do you like to sing songs?
questions.noFollowUp: What do you like to do in your free time?
modelAnswer: Yes. (Please tell me more.) I often sing songs with my friends at karaoke.
No. (What do you like to do in your free time?) I like to read comic books.

sets.title: Riding Bicycles
sets.passage: Many people enjoy riding bicycles. Bicycles are good for our health, and they do not make the air dirty. Some people go to school by bicycle, so they can get exercise every day.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why can some people get exercise every day?
modelAnswer: Because they go to school by bicycle.

questions.prompt: Please look at the picture. Where is the dog?
modelAnswer: It's under the bench.
extraCheckPoints: It's ＋ 場所を表す語句（under the bench など）の形で答えているか

questions.prompt: Please look at the woman. What is she doing?
modelAnswer: She's riding a bicycle.
extraCheckPoints: is ＋ -ing の形で答えているか

questions.prompt: How do you usually go to school?
modelAnswer: I usually go to school by bus.

questions.prompt: Do you often watch sports on TV?
questions.noFollowUp: What do you like to watch on TV?
modelAnswer: Yes. (Please tell me more.) I often watch baseball games with my father.
No. (What do you like to watch on TV?) I like to watch music programs.

sets.title: Camping
sets.passage: Camping is popular in Japan. People can cook outside and look at beautiful stars at night. Many campsites lend tents to visitors, so people can go camping without their own tents.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why can people go camping without their own tents?
modelAnswer: Because many campsites lend tents to visitors.

questions.prompt: Please look at the picture. What is the man doing?
modelAnswer: He's cooking meat.
extraCheckPoints: is ＋ -ing の形で答えているか
cooking だけでも、cooking meat / having a barbecue でもよい

questions.prompt: Please look at the girl. What is she going to do?
modelAnswer: She's going to catch a fish.
extraCheckPoints: be going to ＋ 動詞の原形で答えているか
catch a fish / fish / go fishing はどれも正解とする

questions.prompt: What do you like to do in summer?
modelAnswer: I like to swim in the sea.

questions.prompt: Have you ever cooked dinner for your family?
questions.noFollowUp: What would you like to cook in the future?
modelAnswer: Yes. (Please tell me more.) I made curry and rice for my family last Sunday.
No. (What would you like to cook in the future?) I'd like to cook spaghetti.

sets.title: Making Sweets
sets.passage: Many young people enjoy making sweets at home. They often find easy recipes on the Internet. Homemade cookies and cakes make good presents, so people often give them to their friends.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why do people often give homemade cookies and cakes to their friends?
modelAnswer: Because they make good presents.

questions.prompt: Please look at the picture. How many eggs are there on the table?
modelAnswer: There are three eggs.
extraCheckPoints: There are ＋ 数 の形で答えているか

questions.prompt: Please look at the boy. What is he doing?
modelAnswer: He's washing the dishes.
extraCheckPoints: is ＋ -ing の形で答えているか

questions.prompt: What did you do last Sunday?
modelAnswer: I went shopping with my sister.

questions.prompt: Do you like to cook?
questions.noFollowUp: What do you like to do at home?
modelAnswer: Yes. (Please tell me more.) I often make pancakes on weekends.
No. (What do you like to do at home?) I like to play video games.

sets.title: Visiting Aquariums
sets.passage: Aquariums are popular places for families. Visitors can see many kinds of sea animals there. Some aquariums have exciting shows with dolphins and sea lions, so children can enjoy watching them.

questions.prompt: Please look at the passage. Why can children enjoy watching shows at some aquariums?
modelAnswer: Because some aquariums have exciting shows with dolphins and sea lions.

questions.prompt: Please look at the picture. Where is the turtle?
modelAnswer: It's on the rock.
extraCheckPoints: It's ＋ 場所を表す語句の形で答えているか
on the rock が基本。in the water / in the tank も絵と合っていれば認める

questions.prompt: Please look at the boy. What is he going to do?
modelAnswer: He's going to eat ice cream.
extraCheckPoints: be going to ＋ 動詞の原形で答えているか

questions.prompt: Where would you like to go next summer?
modelAnswer: I'd like to go to Okinawa.

questions.noFollowUp: What animal would you like to have?

No. (What animal would you like to have?) I'd like to have a dog.
